source.title: Bullet Heaven
source.description:
You might be thinking, "but what if I wanted an ammo pouch instead," and "if I say something, will she make me stand in front of bullets too?" I can't read your mind, but a good ranger is great at making predictions.

Truth is: we don't use bullets around here, despite my advocacy of such. Were a pile of bullets to, say, land at my feet, I suppose I would have no choice but to design a proper pouch to contain them.

If only.
source.objective: Craft or purchase Thorium Shells from a player with the Engineering profession and bring them to Kyndra Swiftarrow near the New Avalon archery range.
source.progress: Ho-hum! If only someone would deliver unto us a stockpile of bullets! That sure would be swell.
source.completion:
Ah, you're back and with an ample supply of bullets. You're great at dodging projectiles AND taking hints! I'm proud of you.

Since you were willing to put your life at risk to recover some shoddy training arrows, I figured you would be back after being given a trivial task. I have already taken the time to design a proper pouch.

I still have to convince my commander to invest in guns, but at least now I have some ammunition.
